question.text: A plane <math><mi>P</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> passes through the line of intersection of the planes <math><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>z</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>z</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>. If the plane <math><mi>P</mi></math> divides the line joining <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mn>3</mn><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> in the ratio <math><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mo>:</mo><mn>1</mn></math> internally and the  equation of the plane is <math><mi>a</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>z</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>c</mi></math> where <math><mi>a</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>N</mi></math>, then the value of <math><mn>3</mn><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>b</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>5</mn><mi>c</mi></math> is equal to

solution.text:
The equation of the plane is x+y+z+3+λx-y+z-2=0
⇒x1+λ+y1-λ+z1+λ+3-2λ=0
A point which divides 3,0,2 and 0,3,-1 in 2:1 internally is

2×0+1×33,2×3+0×13,2×-1+1×23
≡1,2,0
This point must satisfy the equation of the plane

⇒1+λ+2-2λ+0+3-2λ=0
⇒6-3λ=0⇒λ=2
Equation of the required plane is 3x-y+3z-1=0
⇒6x-2y+6z=2
⇒a=6,b=6,c=2
Hence, 3a+4b-5c=18+24-10=32
